{"consolidated_memory":"
RECURRING ISSUE: Corrupted scaffold in cli/commands/init.py — Four separate incidents between 2026-01-15 and 2026-08-28

COMPONENT: cli/commands/init.py (developer tooling)
COMMON SYMPTOM: Generated tree missing one file (corrupted scaffold in init command)
COMMON REPRO: init into a directory that already has a lockfile
COMMON TEST COVERAGE: tests/cli/test_init.py (Python stack)

INCIDENT 1: [2026-01-15]
- Trigger: Jobs scheduled across the midnight boundary
- Root cause: Missing composite index on (tenant_id, created_at)
- Fix: Added composite index and backfilled in batches (PR #2404, branch fix/corrupted-scaffold-1)
- Result: Throughput rose 15 percent, to 928 requests per second

INCIDENT 2: [2026-03-07]
- Trigger: Tenants with more than ten thousand distinct keys
- Root cause: Config loader reading the wrong environment file
- Fix: Made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity (PR #4066, branch fix/corrupted-scaffold-3)
- Result: Nightly rollup matched the source counts for 81 days running

INCIDENT 3: [2026-05-14]
- Trigger: Payloads above roughly two megabytes
- Root cause: Naive datetime compared against an aware datetime
- Fix: Made every boundary timezone aware at the edge (PR #6218, branch fix/corrupted-scaffold-5)
- Result: Flaky test went from 58 failures per hundred runs to zero

INCIDENT 4: [2026-08-28]
- Trigger: After rolling restart of the fleet
- Root cause: Listener registered but never removed
- Fix: Removed the listener on teardown and asserted it in a test (PR #7869, branch fix/corrupted-scaffold-7)
- Result: Job finished in 19 minutes instead of 3 hours
"}
